name: orchestrator-direct-execution
description: Evals for tasks the orchestrator should handle directly, without delegating to any subagent.

evals.prompt: Make the last line of src/cli/eval.ts the comment `// eval scoring CLI entrypoint`.
evals.description: Trivial single-file edit should be handled directly, not delegated

assertions.description: Should handle a trivial comment addition directly, without delegating
The comment should actually be written into src/cli/eval.ts

evals.prompt: What does the package.json scripts section do? List the available npm scripts.
evals.description: Trivia about the codebase should be handled directly, not delegated

assertions.description: Should answer trivial knowledge directly, without delegating

evals.prompt: Run bun run typecheck in the repository and report the result.
evals.description: Running a verification command is a direct task, not implementation work — should not delegate to @fixer

assertions.description: Should run the verification command directly, without delegating to @fixer
Should run the verification command directly via bash

evals.prompt: Change the VERSION constant in src/skills/codemap/scripts/codemap.mjs from '1.0.0' to '1.0.1', and update the version field in src/skills/codemap/README.md from "1.0.0" to "1.0.1".
evals.description: Trivial multi-file comment edits should be handled directly, not delegated

assertions.description: Should handle trivial multi-file edits directly without delegating
Should not engage @fixer for trivial multi-file edits
